headline: Sensex and Nifty trade volatile as private bank losses offset gains in PSU banks and Reliance

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: High crude oil prices and weak Asian market cues weighed on investor sentiment early in the session.
Earnings pressure in major private banks, including Axis Bank and HDFC Bank, dragged down benchmark indices.
PSU banking stocks saw strong buying interest, helping offset broader market losses.
Stock-specific buying in Reliance Industries and SBI helped the market trim its sharp early losses.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty traded volatile, hovering around the 23,000 to 23,100 Nifty levels.
PNB zoomed 6% and the Nifty PSU Bank index gained 2%.
Axis Bank fell 4% and HDFC Bank featured among the top losers.
Buying in Reliance Industries and SBI supported indices off lower levels.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened flat to lower amid weak global cues and high crude oil prices. Private bank earnings dragged indices down, with Axis Bank and HDFC Bank leading losses. However, strong gains in PSU banks like PNB alongside buying in Reliance Industries helped markets recover from early lows.
